claim: E3M1 cuts its streets at shadow edges that run along one sun: of 112 shade boundaries in its street surface, 60 are axis-aligned and the 20 oblique ones lie between 52 and 84 degrees with a median of 84 (Build angle 478). Its street shades: 8 lit (nine sectors), 24 penumbra (seven), 32-34 shadow (twenty), 44 for the quay and far bank.
evidence: E3M1's street sectors, measured for projects/blood-city/level/resolution.py:86-102 (SUN_BEARING 478; oblique edges at 52.1, 71.1, 78.7, 82.9, 83.8, 84.2 degrees); E3M1 s8 is cut lengthwise, s45 across
the shadow length equal to the mass's height is a convention (resolution.py SUN_SHADOW_PER_HEIGHT: 'Blood has no real sun elevation'), not a measurement
use: Cast every mass's shadow on one bearing; cut a surface only where a shadow crosses it. Length equal to height is our convention, not a measured one.
